description:
Create a technical drawing with a section view for the T8 Housing Bracket. 

1. Open the file '~/Documents/FreeCAD/T8_housing_bracket.FCStd'.
2. Switch to the TechDraw workbench.
3. Insert a new default Drawing Page (Template).
4. Select the bracket body and insert a standard View on the page.
5. Select this new view and create a Section View (cutaway view) showing the internal details.
6. Save the result as '~/Documents/FreeCAD/housing_drawing.FCStd'.
